limitations: All settings are design assumptions. No physical coupon, friction/retention, peg strength, fatigue, or full-figure assembly was tested.
The 1.1 mm p4 neck and 0.98 mm tip may break or loosen. A 0.2 mm nozzle does not repair wall geometry or prove strength.
The -0.05 mm diametral coupon intentionally intersects; it is not rigidly seatable without deformation.
The socket-wall/roof >=1.2 mm constraint is measured on actual native cavity sections; it is not a minimum cosmetic feature or stem diameter claim.
Appearance caps on exposed cells are cosmetic and are not represented as tested fit connectors.
The two optional Mona temporary cradles in type-plan assembly_aids are not modeled in the figure-brick native CAD assemblies.
Assembly CAD uses shared native external prototype links and ID-mapped arrays. Editing prototype dimensions requires revalidating/regenerating assembly placement assumptions.
P1S 256x256 mm bed and 10 mm margin are assumptions only. No manufacturer profile, slicing, G-code, printer connection, or printing was performed.
Trial layer height, supports, print time and material mass remain UNKNOWN. No full-figure print plates were packed.
Round single-cell joints do not establish rotational retention. Multi-stud seating is a nominal geometric result only.
archive_scope: Historical native geometry checks, not physical fit, retention, or production approval.
public_copy_note: Execution receipts, machine paths and runtime details excluded; use archive/inventory.json for public hashes.
